description: Manage MoreLogin (anti-detect, multi-account browser) profiles and pick the one you work in. Actions: "status" (is MoreLogin installed/running, the default profile, the profile you work in), "list" (profiles), "create" (new profile), "use" (work in a profile yourself: your browser_* tools drive it from then on, in your own tab, without changing the default or disturbing any other session; several sessions can work in different profiles at the same time), "start"/"stop" (launch/close a profile). "use" and "start" take only a profile the owner allowed agents to choose. "use_default" is always refused: the default AI browser is the owner's choice in Settings → Connected tools → MoreLogin (Default AI browser). To work in a profile other than the default, call "use" with its envId or name, then use the browser tools as usual: never tell the user you cannot control a second profile, and never change the default for that. You can choose only a profile the owner allowed agents to choose (the list is the owner's, in SynaBun's Settings; it is empty until the owner switches a profile on, and "list" / "status" show it). When "use" or "start" is refused because the profile is not on that list, nothing was opened, started or changed: tell the user which profile to switch on and where (SynaBun → Settings → Connected tools → MoreLogin → MoreLogin profiles → "Agents may choose"), and do not work in another profile or browser instead. Only Chrome-type profiles can be driven. Requires the MoreLogin desktop app to be running with its local API enabled. Profiles of two kinds are listed and used the same way, by the same ids: MoreLogin profiles, and local profiles (a Chrome SynaBun runs itself on this computer, with its own cookies, proxy, language and timezone; "list" marks them "local"; they work with MoreLogin closed or not installed). Both are on the same owner's list of profiles agents may choose. Local profiles are created, edited and deleted by the owner in Settings only; "create" makes a MoreLogin profile.

action.description: MoreLogin action. "status" = installed/running, the default profile and the profile you work in. "list" = browser profiles (environments). "create" = new profile. "use" = work in a profile yourself: from now on YOUR browser_* tools (with or without session and tab ids) open and drive pages in that profile, in a tab of your own; nobody else moves, and it works while other automations use the default or any other profile. Pass envId or name; envId "default" goes back to the default profile. Your next browser call opens your tab there (the profile is started then) and your tab in the profile you left is closed. Only a profile the owner allowed agents to choose can be used ("list" and "status" say which; none is allowed until the owner switches one on): a refusal with MORELOGIN_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED means the profile is not on the owner's list, so tell the user to switch it on in SynaBun → Settings → Connected tools → MoreLogin → MoreLogin profiles → "Agents may choose" and stop; never use another profile or browser instead. The same list holds for "start": it is refused with MORELOGIN_PROFILE_NOT_ALLOWED for a profile that is not on it. "start"/"stop" = launch/close a profile without working in it (stop closes every tab in that browser: you may stop only a profile you started or have a tab in, and never while other automations have a tab in it). "use_default" is always refused: the default AI browser is the owner's choice (Settings → Connected tools → MoreLogin (Default AI browser)); to work in another profile, call "use". "use" works for any session of SynaBun's MCP that proves its id: a run SynaBun started, a side panel, or a CLI window's own session of SynaBun's HTTP MCP. "start" is for a run SynaBun started; the owner does the rest in the MoreLogin tab in Settings.

envId.description: Profile id (a MoreLogin environment id, or a local profile id that starts with "lp-"): required for start and stop; for "use" pass it or name ("default" = back to the default profile). Get ids from the "list" action.

name.description: A profile name: the profile to work in ("use" action, as "list" shows it), or the name of a new profile ("create", default "SynaBun").

name: morelogin
